description: Converts external quantum efficiency and responsivity using CODATA 2018 h, c and e, and computes photocurrent and unity-gain shot noise following Hamamatsu. Returns dark and illuminated shot-noise NEP, sourced Si/Ge/In0.53Ga0.47As bandgap thresholds and LED photon energy; excludes thermal, amplifier and excess noise.
name: photodiode_responsivity
title: Photodiode responsivity calculator
